resources.string: Allow SiftAlpha X to keep running in the background

Python scripts, local Web services, and long-running projects can be paused or reclaimed by Android battery policies. In system battery settings, consider setting SiftAlpha X to Unrestricted (the wording varies by device).
SiftAlpha X does not change this system setting automatically.
Battery settings could not be opened directly. Find SiftAlpha X battery usage in system settings.
